title: The War Within
description: Even after we belong to God, there's a battle inside us between our old sinful desires and the new life his Spirit gives us.

waypoints.title: Two Directions
waypoints.body: Paul described wanting to do good but struggling against sin -- and pointed to the Spirit's power to win that fight. This war doesn't mean something is wrong with you; it means you belong to God and the old you is losing.

waypoints.title: Ask for Help
waypoints.body: What's one thing you want to do but your 'flesh' fights against -- like being patient with a sibling? Ask God's Spirit for help with it this week.
